source.author: cic
source.text: In quibus non verbum pro verbo necesse habui reddere, sed genus omne verborum vimque servavi.
source.text_original: In quibus non verbum pro verbo necesse habui reddere, sed genus omne verborum vimque servavi.
source.text_english: In these I did not consider it necessary to render word for word, but I have preserved the whole character and force of the words.
